subject: psychology

items.q: Does a correlation prove that one thing causes another?
items.correct: No — correlation shows a relationship, not causation.
items.misconception: Yes, a correlation proves cause and effect.
items.why: Only controlled experiments can establish cause; correlations can be due to other variables.

items.q: Why do psychologists use larger samples?
items.correct: To improve reliability and how representative the findings are.
items.random_wrong: Because a small sample is always representative.
items.why: Bigger, well-chosen samples reduce the impact of unusual individuals; they don't change the true effect size.
